scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
^FF0000Chicken Eggs^000000! Come and
buy as many Chicken Eggs
as you want, whenever you
want! Hey buddy, you wanna
take a look at the Chicken
Eggs that I'm selling?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
^FF0000鸡蛋^000000！快来买呀，想买多少就买多少，随时都能买！
嘿，朋友，要不要看看我卖的鸡蛋？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text: Why Chicken Eggs?
scripts.translation: 为什么是鸡蛋？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy some.
scripts.translation: 好，我买一些

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
What am I--? I'm
selling Chicken Eggs!
For this special event
period, I'm selling as many
Chicken Eggs as you could
want for only 500 zeny each!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我在做什么？当然是在卖鸡蛋！
活动期间，想买多少都行，每个只要500 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Boys, girls, friends,
family, old people, young
people, um, maybe not most
vegetarians or raw foodists,
but almost everyone likes eggs!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
不管是男孩女孩、亲朋好友，还是老人年轻人，几乎人人都爱吃鸡蛋！
嗯...大多数素食主义者和生食主义者可能不算。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Can you imagine a world
without eggs? There'd be
no bread, pastries, cake
or frosting... Ice cream
would be a lot runnier...
Pranks wouldn't be as fun...
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
能想象没有鸡蛋的世界吗？
就没有面包、糕点、蛋糕，也没有糖霜...
冰淇淋会稀得多，恶作剧也没那么好玩了...

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
I'm not really sure why, but
Chicken Eggs are popular
around this time of year.
They're hot items right
now, and I aim to cash in!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我也不知道为什么，每年这个时候鸡蛋都特别受欢迎。
现在卖得正火，我当然要趁机赚一笔！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Great! How many do you
want? Remember that each
Chicken Egg is 500 zeny.
Remember that you won't
always be able to buy
Chicken Eggs so easily!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
好！要多少个？每个500 Zeny。
可不是随时都能这么方便地买到鸡蛋哦！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, if you're not
going to buy anything,
then would you mind getting
out of the way so I can
help out my customers?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，不买的话，麻烦让一让，我还得招呼其他客人呢。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, you mind giving
me a real number? I also
can't sell you more than
1,000 Chicken Eggs at a time,
you know. C'mon, tell me how
many you want for real now.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
嘿，能不能报个靠谱的数量？
一次最多卖1,000个鸡蛋。
说吧，到底要多少？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
你的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
No discount, go and get enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
不打折，去凑够Zeny吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, I know you really
want to buy some Chicken
Eggs, but you won't be able
to carry that much now. Why
don't you free up some
Inventory space first?.
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
我知道你想买鸡蛋，可你现在放不下这么多。
先腾出些物品栏空间吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Here's your Chicken Eggs!
I guess there's some festival
happening where you'll need
them, but I don't know anything
about that. Well, have a good
time, and I'll see you again!
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
鸡蛋给你！
大概有什么节庆要用到它们吧，不过我也不清楚。
玩得开心，下次再见！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Not interested in buying
Chicken Eggs, huh? Well,
word's going around that
there's some kind of festival
where they'll come in handy...
Can you really pass this up?
scripts.translation:
[卖蛋人]
不想买鸡蛋啊？
听说有个节庆正好要用到它们...
真要错过这个机会？

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
This festival is going
to be so much fun! Ooh!
I should buy some Chicken
Eggs to make some decorations.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
这个节庆一定很好玩！
哦！得买些鸡蛋来做装饰。

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
Speaking of which,
I've heard the nun that
can make Holy Eggs is back
in Prontera. Though, I think
she's using Chicken Eggs rather
than regular Eggs to make them.
scripts.translation:
[土气的主妇]
说起来，听说那位会做圣蛋的修女又回到普隆德拉了。
不过，她现在好像用的是鸡蛋，不是普通的蛋。

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
.Hey, do you know how
Chicken Eggs got to be so
expensive? I mean, 500 zeny
is a lot! I think it's because
some guy in Morocc is trying
to amass a ton of Holy Eggs!
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
嘿，知道鸡蛋怎么变得这么贵吗？
一个500 Zeny，可不便宜！
我看是梦罗克有个家伙想囤一大堆圣蛋，才闹成这样的！

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
I don't know what he's
offering for those Holy
Eggs, but adventurers are
coming to him with Holy Eggs
in droves. I wonder what he's
giving to them in return?
scripts.translation:
[脾气古怪的老头]
不知道他拿什么换圣蛋，冒险者们却成群结队地带着圣蛋去找他。
到底能换到什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Hello! If you'd like,
I can take your Chicken
Eggs and transform them
into Holy Eggs. It's something
I do for others in celebration
of this holy season.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
你好！你愿意的话，我可以把鸡蛋变成圣蛋。
这是我为庆祝这个神圣的节日，给大家提供的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Holy Eggs represent
rebirth and, fittingly,
can be used to restore
life to your friends.
Would you like me to
make some for you?
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
圣蛋象征重生，也确实能让你的朋友起死回生。
需要我帮你做一些吗？

scripts.text: What do I need to make Holy Eggs?
scripts.translation: 制作圣蛋需要什么材料？

scripts.text: I want to make Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation: 我想制作圣蛋

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
For each Holy Egg
that you want me to
make, you will need
to bring me...
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
每制作一枚圣蛋，需要带来...

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
^4D4DFF1个白色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个绿色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个黄色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个圣水^000000
^4D4DFF1个鸡蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, how many
Holy Eggs would you
like me to make you?
I can only make up to
10 Holy Eggs at a time.
Enter ''0'' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
要做多少枚圣蛋？
一次最多10枚。
输入0取消。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Oh, you changed your
mind? Feel free to visit me
whenever you want me to
make you some Holy Eggs~
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
哦，您改变主意了？
随时欢迎回来找我制作圣蛋哦~

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but I can only
make up to 10 Holy Eggs
at a time. If you wanted to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，一次最多只能做10枚圣蛋。
想取消的话，输入0就好。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough items to make
Holy Eggs. You need the
following for me to create
each Holy Egg for you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，您的材料不足，无法制作圣蛋。
制作每一枚圣蛋都需要以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
^4D4DFF1个白色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个绿色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个黄色药草^000000
^4D4DFF1个圣水^000000
^4D4DFF1个鸡蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you
won't be able to carry
that many Holy Eggs now...
You'd better free up more
space in your Inventory first.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
抱歉，你现在放不下这么多圣蛋...
先腾出些物品栏空间吧。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Thank you!
I hope you enjoy
these Holy Eggs~
Hope you to be with God's love.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
谢谢！希望这些圣蛋能帮到你~
愿神的爱与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, I understand.
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[内尔伦]
好的，我明白了。
愿上帝保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
How are you doing?
Death... It's inescapable.
Even you'll die someday. But...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你好吗？
死亡...是无法逃避的。
你终有一天也会死去。但是...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Oh, yes. That's it.
You have it. The egg you
hold has a secret power.
I think that... Yes. Someone
like you would understand
us, fit well into our group.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
哦，没错，就是它。
你手中的蛋蕴藏着神秘力量。
我想...对，像你这样的人，一定能理解我们，也很适合加入我们的组织。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Why don't
you... Join us?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
何不...加入我们？

scripts.text: What for?
scripts.translation: 为了什么？

scripts.text: Um... But you're suspicious!
scripts.translation: 嗯...但你们很可疑！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
I see I've caught your
interest! Well, if you'd
like to join us and learn
more, then why don't you
bring me 10 Holy Eggs?
That is my condition.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
看来你感兴趣了！
想加入我们、了解更多的话，带10枚圣蛋来吧。
这是我的条件。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Really? Well, I suppose
I can't help it. Let me
assure you that our
organization works
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
是吗？那也没办法。
不过我可以保证，我们的组织是为了更崇高的善而行动。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We should all enjoy
life while we still can.
Who knows? Perhaps
there will be other lives
to live after this one.
Perhaps, perhaps....
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
趁还能享受生活，我们都该好好活着。
谁知道呢？这一生结束后，也许还有来生。
也许吧，也许...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you have returned.
Did you still wish to
join our ranks? If so,
I hope you brought the
10 Holy Eggs I require.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。
还想加入我们吗？想的话，希望你已经带齐了10枚圣蛋。

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
So you do wish to
join our organization.
First, let me check if you
brought the Holy Eggs...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
看来你是真的想加入我们的组织了。
首先，让我检查一下你是否带来了圣蛋...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Very well. In return
for these Holy Eggs, let
me give you a small present
for joining us. Now, I can
tell you about what we do.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
很好，收下这些圣蛋后，我会送你一份加入组织的小礼物。
现在，可以告诉你我们在做什么了。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Excuse me, I've got--
^333333*Cough!*^000000 A... A bit of a
sore throat. Give me a sec...

[Corps Member]
Hm. You don't have enough
Holy Eggs to meet the condition
I set for you. Did you leave
them in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯，圣蛋数量不够，没达到我提出的条件。
是不是放在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? I suppose I can't
blame you for being a bit
suspicious of us. Let me
assure you that ours is
a mission of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？你对我们有些怀疑，也不能怪你。
不过我可以保证，我们的使命是神圣的。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We are an organization
that is dedicated to...
Resurrecting dead heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们是一个致力于...
复活已故英雄的组织！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Those Holy Eggs that you've
brought have the power to
restore life to the dead.
In large quantities...
They can even revive
ancient fallen heroes!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你带来的圣蛋能让死者重获生命。
数量足够的话...甚至能复活远古逝去的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
When you bring me
33 Holy Eggs, I will
enchant them so that you
can use them on areas where
ancient heroes had died.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
带33枚圣蛋来，我就给它们附魔。
这样，你就能在远古英雄死去的地方使用它们。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go and bring me
33 Holy Eggs! I shall be
waiting here for your return...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去吧，给我带来33枚圣蛋！
我会在这里等待你的归来...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you've returned
Now, did you bring me
33 Holy Eggs for your task?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，你回来了。
任务要用的33枚圣蛋，带来了吗？

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出圣蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出圣蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, these will do!
Now, make a note of the
destination I describe as
I infuse these Holy Eggs
with additional magic.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，这些就够了！
我给圣蛋注入额外魔力的时候，你把我说的目的地记下来。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往斐扬迷宫入口，一位身手敏捷的英雄在那里死去。
在那儿献上圣蛋，然后回来找我。
去吧，让他重获生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
去依斯鲁得岛迷宫第3层...
一位追求智慧的英雄，死在通往第4层的入口。
在那里献上圣蛋，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往废弃矿洞迷宫，一位英勇的英雄曾为保护同伴而死在那里。
一到第3层，就献上圣蛋。
去吧，让他重获生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往格拉斯特海姆，进入第2层后就献上圣蛋。
一位英雄在那里死去，你要让他重返人间！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? This isn't
33 Holy Eggs. Did you
leave some in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嗯？圣蛋不够33枚。
是不是有一些放在仓库里了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Don't you understand
the righteousness of
our cause? Returning fallen
heroes will bring peace to
our lands much more quickly!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
你还不明白我们做的事有多正义吗？
让逝去的英雄复活，这片土地就能更快迎来和平！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Did you forget
where you must go?
Let me remind you
so that you do not
lose your way...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
忘了该去哪里吗？
我再告诉你一遍，免得走错...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
前往斐扬迷宫入口，一位身手敏捷的英雄在那里死去。
在那儿献上圣蛋，然后回来找我。
去吧，让他重获生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
去依斯鲁得岛迷宫第3层...
一位追求智慧的英雄，死在通往第4层的入口。
在那里献上圣蛋，让他复活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
[军团成员]
前往废弃矿洞迷宫，一位英勇的英雄曾为保护同伴而死在那里。
一到第3层，就献上圣蛋。
去吧，让他重获生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
前往格拉斯特海姆，进入第2层后就献上圣蛋。
一位英雄在那里死去，你要让他重返人间！

scripts.text: [Corps Member]
scripts.translation: [军团成员]

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, I hope you've come
back with good news.
So did it work?
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
啊，希望你带来的是好消息。
成功了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually...
Nothing happened....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实...
什么也没发生...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
What? It can't be.
The magic... It should
have been powerful enough...
Well, it's too bad that we
failed. Even so, I am grateful
for all your help thus far...
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
什么？不可能。
魔法...应该足够强才对...
可惜，我们失败了。
不过，还是很感谢你一直以来的帮助...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We'll investigate what
could have gone wrong,
and then try again next year.
Farewell, my friend, and I hope
that you'll assist us again.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
我们会查清哪里出了问题，明年再试一次。
再见，朋友，希望到时候你还愿意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Shh! Tell no one
that I am here.
scripts.translation:
[军团成员]
嘘！别告诉别人我在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
This is the place
the Corps Member
wanted me to find...
Time to use all of
these Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...这就是军团成员让我找的地方...
该把这些圣蛋全用掉了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we go...
Will this really bring
this ancient hero
back to life? I'm...
